name: Mosaic Research Management MCP
description:
Mosaic Expert Search connects your AI assistant to Mosaic Research Management's expert network. Search across expert bios, work histories, and Mosaic's own vetting write-ups to build a shortlist of the people worth a call — without leaving your assistant.

Three tools: keyword expert search (with company and job-title filters), a full expert profile (work history plus bio/vetting write-ups), and the expert's individual vetting summaries in full.

Read-only and privacy-preserving: results never include contact details, and carry no client or project identifiers. To arrange a call, you give your Mosaic team the expert's name and ID.

For Mosaic clients. Requires a Mosaic client-portal account with AI expert search enabled — ask your Mosaic team to turn it on.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mosaic Research Management MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mosaic Research Management MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mosaicrm.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mosaic Research Management MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mosaic Research Management MCP provides these MCP tools: get_expert_applications, get_expert_profile, and search_experts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mosaic Research Management MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mosaic Research Management MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Mosaic Research Management MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mosaic Research Management MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Mosaic Research Management MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mosaic Research Management MCP is developed by Mosaic RM. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
